_comment: Interactive hotspot map over the manual's own machine diagrams.
Coordinates are normalized (0-1) against the image, so they hold at any
render size. Circles use cx/cy/r (r as a fraction of image WIDTH); rects use
x/y/w/h. Each part carries the page it is labelled on, keywords the agent and
the troubleshooting layer match against, and a one-line note.
Verified by overlaying these boxes on the source figures and eyeballing the
fit, the same loop used for the figure crops.

front-panel.title: Front panel
front-panel.caption: The front of the welder: display, control knobs, power switch and the output sockets.

parts.label: LCD Display
parts.note: The 4.3" synergic control screen.

parts.label: Home Button
parts.note: Returns to the process-selection screen.

parts.label: Back Button
parts.note: Steps back to the previous screen.

parts.label: Left Knob (Wire Feed Speed / Amperage)
parts.note: Sets wire diameter, then wire feed speed / amperage.

parts.label: Main Control Knob
parts.note: Turn to move through menus, press to select.

parts.label: Right Knob (Voltage / Thickness)
parts.note: Sets material thickness, then voltage.

parts.label: Power Switch
parts.note: Main on/off. Leave ON while the machine cools after a thermal trip.

parts.label: MIG Gun / Spool Gun Cable Socket
parts.note: Where the MIG gun (or optional spool gun) connects.

parts.label: Storage Compartment
parts.note: Behind the vented door — holds the door-mounted settings chart.

parts.label: Spool Gun Gas Outlet
parts.note: Gas fitting for the optional spool gun.

parts.label: Negative (−) Socket
parts.note: The (−) output socket. Ground clamp here for MIG and stick; torch here for TIG; wire feed power here for flux-cored.

parts.label: Wire Feed Power Cable
parts.note: Short internal lead that plugs into (+) for MIG or (−) for flux-cored.

parts.label: Positive (+) Socket
parts.note: The (+) output socket. Wire feed power here for MIG; electrode holder here for stick; ground clamp here for TIG and flux-cored.

interior.title: Wire compartment (interior)
interior.caption: Inside the wire-drive door: spool, feed mechanism, tensioner and the feed-control sockets.

parts.label: Wire Spool
parts.note: Holds up to a 12 lb spool. Check here for tangles or cross-winding.

parts.label: Spool Tension Knob
parts.note: Sets spool drag so it does not overspin.

parts.label: Wire Feed Mechanism
parts.note: The drive assembly that pushes wire to the gun.

parts.label: Feed Tensioner
parts.note: Sets how hard the drive grips the wire. Too tight bird-nests; too loose slips.

parts.label: Idler Arm
parts.note: Swings the pressure roller onto the wire.

parts.label: Feed Roller Knob
parts.note: Holds the drive roll. Flip it for the correct groove and wire size.

parts.label: Wire Inlet Liner
parts.note: Guides wire from the spool into the drive.

parts.label: Cold Wire Feed Switch
parts.note: Feeds wire without power, to thread the gun.

parts.label: Foot Pedal Socket
parts.note: TIG foot pedal connects here, inside the machine.

parts.label: Wire Feed Control Socket
parts.note: The MIG gun's control lead connects here.
